links.comparator_used: Unaugmented general LLMs Claude-2 and GPT-4, evaluated against expert multidisciplinary tumor board recommendations as the reference
links.outcome: Accuracy/concordance of adjuvant therapy recommendations for postoperative breast cancer cases across seven treatment modalities
links.effect: TSB overall accuracy 0.89, Claude-2 0.86, GPT-4 0.78; GPT-4 had lower accuracy in genetic testing recommendations (OR, 0.05 [95% CI, 0.015 to 0.149]; P < .001), and Claude-2 was less accurate in radiotherapy recommendations (OR, 0.41 [95% CI, 0.17 to 0.98]; P = .040).
links.quote: TSB demonstrated the highest overall accuracy (0.89), followed by Claude-2 (0.86) and GPT-4 (0.78).
